1	# ShiftWise — Simplify Restaurant Team Management
     2	
     3	## Brand
     4	ShiftWise is an all-in-one workforce management platform built for the restaurant and hospitality industry. It helps owners and managers streamline scheduling, team communication, and labor compliance — so they can focus on running great restaurants instead of wrestling with spreadsheets.
     5	
     6	Tone: Professional, modern, bold
     7	Brand colors: #0051C3 (primary blue), #DE5052 (accent red), #FFFFFF (white)
     8	
     9	## Hero Content
    10	Title: Your Restaurant Runs Better When Your Team Is in Sync
    11	Subtitle: ShiftWise gives restaurant owners and managers the scheduling, communication, and compliance tools they need — all in one platform. Spend less time on admin and more time delighting guests.
    12	CTA: "Start Your Free Trial" | "See How It Works"
    13	
    14	## How It Works
    15	1. **Build Your Schedule** — Use drag-and-drop tools to create optimized weekly schedules in minutes, not hours.
    16	2. **Keep Everyone Connected** — Broadcast shift updates, swap requests, and announcements through built-in team messaging.
    17	3. **Stay Compliant Automatically** — Get real-time alerts for overtime, break violations, and local labor law requirements.
    18	4. **Track & Optimize** — Monitor labor costs, attendance trends, and team performance from a single dashboard.
    19	
    20	## Core Features
    21	- **Drag-and-drop scheduling** — Build and publish weekly schedules with an intuitive visual editor. Auto-fill based on availability and roles.
    22	- **Team messaging** — Communicate with individuals, shift groups, or your entire staff. No more lost group texts.
    23	- **Labor law compliance alerts** — Automatic notifications for overtime thresholds, predictive scheduling laws, and mandatory break periods.
    24	- **POS integrations** — Connect with leading point-of-sale systems to align labor costs with real-time sales data.
    25	- **Time clocking** — GPS-enabled clock-in/clock-out from any mobile device. Eliminate buddy punching with photo verification.
    26	
    27	## Feature: Scheduling
    28	Create conflict-free schedules in minutes. ShiftWise automatically factors in employee availability, time-off requests, certifications, and labor budget targets. Managers can copy previous weeks, use templates, or let the auto-scheduler do the heavy lifting. Employees receive instant mobile notifications when schedules are published or updated.
    29	
    30	## Feature: Team Communication
    31	Replace scattered text threads with a centralized messaging hub. Send shift reminders, broadcast announcements, and manage shift swap requests — all within the app. Read receipts ensure critical messages are seen, and managers can pin important updates for new hires.
    32	
    33	## Feature: Labor Compliance
    34	Navigate complex and ever-changing labor regulations with confidence. ShiftWise monitors federal, state, and local labor laws — including predictive scheduling ordinances, minor work-hour restrictions, and overtime rules — and flags potential violations before they happen.
    35	
    36	## Integrations
    37	ShiftWise connects seamlessly with the tools restaurants already use:
    38	- **Point of Sale** — Toast, Square, Clover, Lightspeed
    39	- **Payroll** — ADP, Gusto, Paychex, QuickBooks
    40	- **Accounting** — Xero, FreshBooks, Sage
    41	- **Delivery platforms** — DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub
    42	
    43	## Platform Stats
    44	- **750,000+** shifts scheduled every month
    45	- **35,000+** restaurant managers on the platform
    46	- **98%** customer satisfaction rate
    47	- **15 hrs/week** average time saved per manager
    48	
    49	## Pricing Plans
    50	
    51	| Feature | Free | Starter ($29.99/mo) | Premium ($69.99/mo) |
    52	|---|---|---|---|
    53	| Locations | 1 | Up to 3 | Unlimited locations |
    54	| Employees | Up to 15 | Up to 50 | Unlimited |
    55	| Drag-and-drop scheduling | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
    56	| Team messaging | — | ✓ | ✓ |
    57	| Labor compliance alerts | — | Basic | Advanced |
    58	| POS integrations | — | ✓ | ✓ |
    59	| Time clocking | — | ✓ | ✓ |
    60	| Demand forecasting | — | — | ✓ |
    61	| Dedicated account manager | — | — | ✓ |
    62	| Support | Email | Email & chat | Priority 24/7 |
    63	
    64	Annual billing saves 20% on Starter and Premium plans.
    65	
    66	## FAQ
    67	- **Is there really a free plan?** — Yes. The Free plan supports one location with up to 15 employees, no credit card required.
    68	- **Can I switch plans at any time?** — Absolutely. Upgrade, downgrade, or cancel anytime from your account settings.
    69	- **Do you offer discounts for multi-location operators?** — Yes. Contact our sales team for custom enterprise pricing on 10+ locations.
    70	- **What happens to my data if I cancel?** — Your data is retained for 90 days after cancellation. You can export everything at any time.
    71	- **Is there a setup fee?** — No. All plans include free onboarding and setup assistance.
    72	
    73	## Testimonials
    74	- "ShiftWise cut our scheduling time from 6 hours to 30 minutes every week. It's been a game-changer for our three-location operation." — **Maria Gonzalez**, General Manager, Fuego Kitchen
    75	- "The compliance alerts alone have saved us from costly violations. I sleep better knowing ShiftWise has our back." — **David Park**, Owner, Noodle Republic
    76	- "Our staff actually loves it — shift swaps happen in seconds and everyone stays in the loop." — **Aisha Thompson**, Operations Director, Greenleaf Café Group
    77	
    78	## Mission
    79	ShiftWise was founded in 2019 by a team of former restaurant operators and software engineers who experienced the chaos of workforce management firsthand. Our mission is to empower every restaurant — from single-unit independents to national chains — with technology that makes managing people as seamless as serving guests.
    80	
    81	## Team
    82	CEO: Rachel Nguyen · CTO: Marcus Webb · CPO: Sofia Alvarez · VP of Customer Success: James Okafor
    83	
    84	## Contact
    85	Have questions or need a personalized demo? Reach out and our team will respond within one business day.
    86	- **Email:** hello@shiftwise.io
    87	- **Phone:** (415) 555-0192
    88	- **Office Locations:** San Francisco, CA (HQ) · Austin, TX · Toronto, ON
    89	
    90	Contact form fields: Full Name, Email, Company Name, Number of Locations, Message
    91	
    92	## CTA Block
    93	Title: Ready to Simplify Your Restaurant Operations?
    94	Subtitle: Join 35,000+ managers who save 15 hours every week with ShiftWise.
    95	CTA: "Start Your Free Trial — No Credit Card Required"
    96

   100	Support: Help Center · Contact · System Status
   101	Legal: Privacy Policy · Terms of Service · Cookie Settings

1 --- 2 name: web-frameworks 3 description: Build modern full-stack web applications with Next.js (App Router, Server Components, RSC, PPR, SSR, SSG, ISR), Turborepo (monorepo management, task pipelines, remote caching, parallel execution), and RemixIcon (3100+ SVG icons in outlined/filled styles). Use when creating React applications, implementing server-side rendering, setting up monorepos with multiple packages, optimizing build performance and caching strategies, adding icon libraries, managing shared dependencies, or working with TypeScript full-stack projects. 4 license: MIT 5 version: 1.0.0 6 --- 7 8 # Web Frameworks Skill Group 9 10 Comprehensive guide for building modern full-stack web applications using Next.js, Turborepo, and RemixIcon. 11 12 ## Overview 13 14 This skill group combines three powerful tools for web development: 15 16 **Next.js** - React framework with SSR, SSG, RSC, and optimization features 17 **Turborepo** - High-performance monorepo build system for JavaScript/TypeScript 18 **RemixIcon** - Icon library with 3,100+ outlined and filled style icons 19 20 ## When to Use This Skill Group 21 22 - Building new full-stack web applications with modern React 23 - Setting up monorepos with multiple apps and shared packages 24 - Implementing server-side rendering and static generation 25 - Optimizing build performance with intelligent caching 26 - Creating consistent UI with professional iconography 27 - Managing workspace dependencies across multiple projects 28 - Deploying production-ready applications with proper optimization 29 30 ## Stack Selection Guide 31 32 ### Single Application: Next.js + RemixIcon 33 34 Use when building a standalone application: 35 - E-commerce sites 36 - Marketing websites 37 - SaaS applications 38 - Documentation sites 39 - Blogs and content platforms 40 41 **Setup:** 42 ```bash 43 npx create-next-app@latest my-app 44 cd my-app 45 npm install remixicon 46 ``` 47 48 ### Monorepo: Next.js + Turborepo + RemixIcon 49 50 Use when building multiple applications with shared code: 51 - Microfrontends 52 - Multi-tenant platforms 53 - Internal tools with shared component library 54 - Multiple apps (web, admin, mobile-web) sharing logic 55 - Design system with documentation site 56 57 **Setup:** 58 ```bash 59 npx create-turbo@latest my-monorepo 60 # Then configure Next.js apps in apps/ directory 61 # Install remixicon in shared UI packages 62 ``` 63 64 ### Framework Features Comparison 65 66 | Feature | Next.js | Turborepo | RemixIcon | 67 |---------|---------|-----------|-----------| 68 | Primary Use | Web framework | Build system | UI icons | 69 | Best For | SSR/SSG apps | Monorepos | Consistent iconography | 70 | Performance | Built-in optimization | Caching & parallel tasks | Lightweight fonts/SVG | 71 | TypeScript | Full support | Full support | Type definitions available | 72 73 ## Quick Start 74 75 ### Next.js Application 76 77 ```bash 78 # Create new project 79 npx create-next-app@latest my-app 80 cd my-app 81 82 # Install RemixIcon 83 npm install remixicon 84 85 # Import in layout 86 # app/layout.tsx 87 import 'remixicon/fonts/remixicon.css' 88 89 # Start development 90 npm run dev 91 ``` 92 93 ### Turborepo Monorepo 94 95 ```bash 96 # Create monorepo 97 npx create-turbo@latest my-monorepo 98 cd my-monorepo 99 100 # Structure: 101 # apps/web/ - Next.js application 102 # apps/docs/ - Documentation site 103 # packages/ui/ - Shared components with RemixIcon 104 # packages/config/ - Shared configs 105 # turbo.json - Pipeline configuration 106 107 # Run all apps 108 npm run dev 109 110 # Build all packages 111 npm run build 112 ``` 113 114 ### RemixIcon Integration 115 116 ```tsx 117 // Webfont (HTML/CSS) 118 119 120 121 // React component 122 import { RiHomeLine, RiSearchFill } from "@remixicon/react" 123 124 125 ``` 126 127 ## Reference Navigation 128 129 **Next.js References:** 130 - [App Router Architecture](./references/nextjs-app-router.md) - Routing, layouts, pages, parallel routes 131 - [Server Components](./references/nextjs-server-components.md) - RSC patterns, client vs server, streaming 132 - [Data Fetching](./references/nextjs-data-fetching.md) - fetch API, caching, revalidation, loading states 133 - [Optimization](./references/nextjs-optimization.md) - Images, fonts, scripts, bundle analysis, PPR 134 135 **Turborepo References:** 136 - [Setup & Configuration](./references/turborepo-setup.md) - Installation, workspace config, package structure 137 - [Task Pipelines](./references/turborepo-pipelines.md) - Dependencies, parallel execution, task ordering 138 - [Caching Strategies](./references/turborepo-caching.md) - Local cache, remote cache, cache invalidation 139 140 **RemixIcon References:** 141 - [Integration Guide](./references/remix-icon-integration.md) - Installation, usage, customization, accessibility 142 143 ## Common Patterns & Workflows 144 145 ### Pattern 1: Full-Stack Monorepo 146 147 ``` 148 my-monorepo/ 149 ├── apps/ 150 │ ├── web/ # Customer-facing Next.js app 151 │ ├── admin/ # Admin dashboard Next.js app 152 │ └── docs/ # Documentation site 153 ├── packages/ 154 │ ├── ui/ # Shared UI with RemixIcon 155 │ ├── api-client/ # API client library 156 │ ├── config/ # ESLint, TypeScript configs 157 │ └── types/ # Shared TypeScript types 158 └── turbo.json # Build pipeline 159 ``` 160 161 **turbo.json:** 162 ```json 163 { 164 "$schema": "https://turbo.build/schema.json", 165 "pipeline": { 166 "build": { 167 "dependsOn": ["^build"], 168 "outputs": [".next/**", "!.next/cache/**", "dist/**"] 169 }, 170 "dev": { 171 "cache": false, 172 "persistent": true 173 }, 174 "lint": {}, 175 "test": { 176 "dependsOn": ["build"] 177 } 178 } 179 } 180 ``` 181 182 ### Pattern 2: Shared Component Library 183 184 ```tsx 185 // packages/ui/src/button.tsx 186 import { RiLoader4Line } from "@remixicon/react" 187 188 export function Button({ children, loading, icon }) { 189 return ( 190 194 ) 195 } 196 197 // apps/web/app/page.tsx 198 import { Button } from "@repo/ui/button" 199 import { RiHomeLine } from "@remixicon/react" 200 201 export default function Page() { 202 return 203 } 204 ``` 205 206 ### Pattern 3: Optimized Data Fetching 207 208 ```tsx 209 // app/posts/[slug]/page.tsx 210 import { notFound } from 'next/navigation' 211 212 // Static generation at build time 213 export async function generateStaticParams() { 214 const posts = await getPosts() 215 return posts.map(post => ({ slug: post.slug })) 216 } 217 218 // Revalidate every hour 219 async function getPost(slug: string) { 220 const res = await fetch(`https://api.example.com/posts/${slug}`, { 221 next: { revalidate: 3600 } 222 }) 223 if (!res.ok) return null 224 return res.json() 225 } 226 227 export default async function Post({ params }: { params: { slug: string } }) { 228 const post = await getPost(params.slug) 229 if (!post) notFound() 230 231 return
{post.content}
232 } 233 ``` 234 235 ### Pattern 4: Monorepo CI/CD Pipeline 236 237 ```yaml 238 # .github/workflows/ci.yml 239 name: CI 240 on: [push, pull_request] 241 242 jobs: 243 build: 244 runs-on: ubuntu-latest 245 steps: 246 - uses: actions/checkout@v4 247 - uses: actions/setup-node@v4 248 with: 249 node-version: 18 250 - run: npm install 251 - run: npx turbo run build test lint 252 env: 253 TURBO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TURBO_TOKEN }} 254 TURBO_TEAM: ${{ secrets.TURBO_TEAM }} 255 ``` 256 257 ## Utility Scripts 258 259 Python utilities in `scripts/` directory: 260 261 **nextjs-init.py** - Initialize Next.js project with best practices 262 **turborepo-migrate.py** - Convert existing monorepo to Turborepo 263 264 Usage examples: 265 ```bash 266 # Initialize new Next.js app with TypeScript and recommended setup 267 python scripts/nextjs-init.py --name my-app --typescript --app-router 268 269 # Migrate existing monorepo to Turborepo with dry-run 270 python scripts/turborepo-migrate.py --path ./my-monorepo --dry-run 271 272 # Run tests 273 cd scripts/tests 274 pytest 275 ``` 276 277 ## Best Practices 278 279 **Next.js:** 280 - Default to Server Components, use Client Components only when needed 281 - Implement proper loading and error states 282 - Use Image component for automatic optimization 283 - Set proper metadata for SEO 284 - Leverage caching strategies (force-cache, revalidate, no-store) 285 286 **Turborepo:** 287 - Structure monorepo with clear separation (apps/, packages/) 288 - Define task dependencies correctly (^build for topological) 289 - Configure outputs for proper caching 290 - Enable remote caching for team collaboration 291 - Use filters to run tasks on changed packages only 292 293 **RemixIcon:** 294 - Use line style for minimal interfaces, fill for emphasis 295 - Maintain 24x24 grid alignment for crisp rendering 296 - Provide aria-labels for accessibility 297 - Use currentColor for flexible theming 298 - Prefer webfonts for multiple icons, SVG for single icons 299 300 ## Resources 301 302 - Next.js: https://nextjs.org/docs/llms.txt 303 - Turborepo: https://turbo.build/repo/docs 304 - RemixIcon: https://remixicon.com 305 306 ## Implementation Checklist 307 308 Building with this stack: 309 310 - [ ] Create project structure (single app or monorepo) 311 - [ ] Configure TypeScript and ESLint 312 - [ ] Set up Next.js with App Router 313 - [ ] Configure Turborepo pipeline (if monorepo) 314 - [ ] Install and configure RemixIcon 315 - [ ] Implement routing and layouts 316 - [ ] Add loading and error states 317 - [ ] Configure image and font optimization 318 - [ ] Set up data fetching patterns 319 - [ ] Configure caching strategies 320 - todos.title: Create shared CSS and JS utilities

steps.message:
The ShiftWise 5-page marketing website is complete and fully tested. Here's a summary of what was built:

---

### Output Files (`/app/output/`)

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `index.html` | Home page with hero, features, how-it-works, testimonials carousel, animated stats, pricing teaser, and CTA |
| `features.html` | Features page with detailed sections for Scheduling, Team Communication, Labor Compliance, and Integrations |
| `pricing.html` | Pricing page with monthly/annual toggle, 3-tier cards, detailed comparison table, and FAQ accordion |
| `about.html` | About page with mission story, leadership team, and stats counter |
| `contact.html` | Contact page with validated form, success confirmation, and office locations |
| `styles.css` | Shared stylesheet with responsive design, mobile nav, and all component styles |
| `main.js` | Shared JavaScript handling all interactions |

---

### Key Interactions Implemented

- **Mobile Navigation** — Hamburger menu opens a slide-in drawer on all pages
- **Testimonial Carousel** — Auto-advancing with prev/next arrows and dot indicators (Home page)
- **Stats Counter Animation** — Numbers count up when scrolled into view (Home & About)
- **Pricing Toggle** — Monthly/annual billing switch updates prices smoothly (Home & Pricing)
- **FAQ Accordion** — Click to expand/collapse with single-open behavior (Pricing)
- **Contact Form Validation** — Client-side validation for required fields with success confirmation (Contact)

---

### Design System

- **Colors**: Primary blue `#0051C3`, accent red `#DE5052`, clean grays
- **Typography**: Inter font family, geometric sans-serif feel
- **Responsive**: Fully mobile-first with breakpoints at 640px, 768px, and 1024px
- **No build step**: All pages open directly in a browser using relative paths
